topics.title: Decimals and place value
topics.teach: Explain why 0.4 is bigger than 0.35 even though it has fewer digits.
topics.talk: Ask her which is bigger, 0.5 or 0.45, and why.

topics.title: Negative numbers
topics.teach: Explain what subtracting a negative number does.
topics.talk: If it is −3°C and gets 5 degrees warmer, what is the temperature?

topics.title: Fractions on a number line
topics.teach: Explain how you find where 3/4 goes on a number line.
topics.talk: Ask her where 5/4 goes on a ruler that is 2 long.

topics.title: Comparing fractions
topics.talk: Would she rather have 2/3 or 3/5 of a pizza? Why?

topics.title: Equivalent fractions and simplifying
topics.teach: Explain how you simplify a fraction.
topics.talk: Ask her to simplify 12/16 in her head.

topics.title: Adding and subtracting fractions
topics.teach: Explain why you can’t just add the denominators.

topics.title: Multiplying and dividing fractions
topics.teach: Explain why multiplying by a fraction smaller than 1 makes a number smaller.
topics.talk: What is half of a quarter?

topics.title: Fractions of amounts
topics.talk: Ask her to find 3/4 of the bill when you next shop.

topics.title: Fractions, decimals and percentages
topics.teach: Explain how to turn 3/5 into a percentage.
topics.talk: Which is better: 30% off or a third off?

topics.title: Percentages of amounts
topics.teach: Explain a quick way to find 15% of something.
topics.talk: Ask her to work out a 10% tip, then 15%.

topics.title: Algebra: substitution
topics.talk: If a = 4, is 2a the same as 24?

topics.title: Sequences and the nth term
topics.teach: Explain the difference between the term-to-term rule and the nth term.

topics.title: Solving equations
topics.talk: I think of a number, double it and add 3. I get 17. What was my number?

topics.title: Ratio and sharing
topics.teach: Explain how to share £40 in the ratio 3 : 5.
topics.talk: Share 12 sweets between you in the ratio 1 : 2.

topics.title: Factors, multiples and primes
topics.teach: Explain why 51 is not a prime number.

topics.title: Angle facts
topics.teach: Explain how you find a missing angle in a triangle.
topics.talk: Ask her what the angles in a triangle add up to.

topics.title: Key facts
topics.teach: Explain how you remember what the angles in a triangle add up to.

items.explain: How many centimetres are in 1 metre: 100.

items.prompt: What is an obtuse angle?

items.prompt: What is the formula for the area of a rectangle?

items.prompt: What is the formula for the area of a triangle?
